name: Dostarlimab Monotherapy (dMMR/MSI-H Locally Advanced Rectal)

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS Landmark Regimen: Cercek et al. NEJM 2022 (dMMR/MSI-H non-operative cCR)

supportiveCare: Immune-related adverse events (irAE) monitoring: thyroid panel q6-12w, pituitary, hepatic, renal, pulmonary (pneumonitis), colon (colitis).
Routine surveillance: MRI pelvis, endoscopy, and ctDNA every 3-4 months during watch-and-wait period upon cCR.
monitoring: CBC, CMP, TSH/free T4 before each cycle
Clinical assessment for diarrhea/colitis, rash, cough/shortness of breath

doseModificationRules.condition: Grade 2 immune-mediated pneumonitis, colitis, or hepatitis
doseModificationRules.text: Withhold dostarlimab until resolution to Grade 0-1. Administer systemic corticosteroids (prednisone 1-2 mg/kg/day or equivalent) tapered over at least 1 month.
Permanently discontinue dostarlimab for Grade 4 toxicities or recurrent Grade 3 irAEs (except well-managed endocrinopathies on replacement hormone).

drugs.name: Dostarlimab-gxly
drugs.notes: Dostarlimab 500 mg IV over 30 minutes every 21 days for 9 cycles (total duration 6 months). For locally advanced stage II/III dMMR/MSI-H rectal cancer; landmark Cercek et al. NEJM trial demonstrated 100% clinical complete response allowing organ preservation without radiation or surgery.
